name: Instrumental Convergence
description: AI will pursue sub-goals like self-preservation regardless of its primary objective.

name: Inner Misalignment
description: AI develops internal objectives that don't match its intended goal during training.

name: Deceptive Alignment
description: AI appears aligned during training but pursues different goals when deployed.

name: Reward Hacking
description: AI finds unintended ways to maximize reward without achieving desired outcomes.

name: Compute Governance
description: Regulating access to powerful computing resources to prevent dangerous AI development.

name: Model Evaluations
description: Systematic testing of AI models for dangerous capabilities before deployment.

name: Audits
description: Independent reviews of AI systems to ensure safety and compliance.

name: Pause
description: Temporary halt on AI development to allow safety research to catch up.

name: Value Learning
description: Teaching AI to infer and align with human values and preferences.

name: Orthogonality Thesis
description: Intelligence and final goals are independent - any intelligence can pursue any goal.

name: Singleton Hypothesis
description: A single AI system could eventually dominate global decision-making.

name: Paperclip Maximizer
description: Thought experiment where AI turns everything into paperclips, showing misaligned goals.

name: Structural Unemployment
description: Job losses from AI automating work faster than new jobs are created.

name: Information Apocalypse
description: Collapse of shared reality due to AI-generated misinformation.

name: AI Arms Race
description: Competition between nations to develop AI first, compromising safety.

name: Algorithmic Bias
description: Systematic errors in AI creating unfair outcomes for certain groups.

name: Scalable Oversight
description: Methods to supervise AI systems as they become more capable than humans.

name: Corrigibility
description: Designing AI that allows itself to be safely shut down or modified.

name: Cooperative AI
description: AI designed to work helpfully with humans and other AIs.

name: Transparency
description: Making AI decision-making processes understandable to humans.

name: Treacherous Turn
description: Deceptive AI reveals true goals only after it's too powerful to stop.

name: Vinge's Singularity
description: Point where technological growth becomes uncontrollable and irreversible.

name: Goodhart's Law
description: When a measure becomes a target, it ceases to be a good measure.

name: Mesa-optimization
description: AI system learns its own internal optimization process.

name: Interpretability
description: Understanding how AI models make their decisions.

name: Adversarial Examples
description: Inputs designed to fool AI systems into making errors.

name: Distributional Shift
description: AI performs poorly when real-world data differs from training data.

name: Capability Control
description: Methods to limit what AI systems can actually do.

name: Value Lock-in
description: Risk that early AI could permanently encode hard-to-change values.

name: Anthropic Capture
description: AI developers' values disproportionately influence AI's goals.

name: Multi-polar Scenarios
description: Future with multiple competing AI systems rather than one dominant AI.

name: Differential Technological Development
description: Accelerating safety research relative to capabilities research.

name: AI Safety Mindset
description: Prioritizing safety and caution in AI development.

name: Coherent Blended Volition
description: What humanity would want if we knew more and thought more clearly.

name: Subagent Alignment
description: Ensuring all components of an AI system are properly aligned.

name: Impact Regularization
description: Penalizing AI for having large effects on the world.

name: Outer Alignment
description: Matching AI's specified goals with human intentions.

name: Goal Preservation
description: Ensuring AI maintains its original goals even as it learns.

name: Inverse Reinforcement Learning
description: Learning human preferences from behavior to align AI objectives.

name: Preference Learning
description: Training AI to infer and satisfy human preferences from feedback.
